title: Cold-reader naming panel (LAUNCH-SPEC section 26, docs/NAMING-RULES.md)
panel: Codex exec (read-only, ephemeral), six cold readers aged 20 to 35 in the US and Canada: a progressive activist, a religious conservative, an ESL speaker, a Gen Z TikTok user, a nurse, an engineer. Each sees only the label and where it sits on the phone, never its intended meaning, and scores clear, hurt and share from 1 to 5.

gate.share: >= 3.5 average, for labels about the player (kind result); headings, chips and buttons (kind ui) take clear and hurt only

inventory: node scripts/naming-inventory.mjs lists every player-facing label on the result with where it sits

rounds.note: the before set rescored with the final method, for a like-for-like comparison
every label as shipped before this pass, plus 143 first candidates
the full chosen set, three pooled runs in shuffled batches

before.note: the labels as shipped before this pass, rescored with the same 18-reader method as the final set (a first 6-reader run passed 88 of 305)

after_gated_only.note: excluding the 8 exempt people names and the locked life names, stats and kicker

summary.note: Scores move between runs: the same label can swing 0.5 to 1 point on clear or hurt from one six-reader run to the next, so both the before set and every final label are scored by 18 readers in three shuffled runs. Labels still under the gate are listed in residual; LAUNCH-SPEC section 26 says why each group stays.
